sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's Bappebti regulatory framework and pending OJK transition are legitimizing crypto as an asset class, driving sustained retail inflows from a 270M-strong, mobile-first population.

Stablecoin and remittance use cases are structurally expanding in Southeast Asia, positioning Indonesian exchanges and payment rails as durable on-ramps for digital asset adoption.
sectors.ai: Accumulate ADA, AVAX, and LINK on pullbacks; ENA and PEPE are momentum trades only—take profits into strength. Indonesia's crypto adoption is accelerating on regulatory clarity (Bappebti) and a young, mobile-first population; rotate into large-cap L1s and oracle infrastructure for sustained beta. Trim ALGO and ARB into rallies; M is a speculative outlier—size down.
